introduction: Illinois SNAP helps eligible households buy groceries through the Illinois Link card. IDHS reviews applications through Family Community Resource Centers.
description: Illinois SNAP helps eligible households buy groceries through the Illinois Link card. IDHS reviews applications through Family Community Resource Centers.

sections.who: IDHS considers income, allowable expenses and the people living and eating together. Its calculator is an estimate, not an eligibility decision. Check the current income and work-rule guidance for your household.
sections.get: Food benefits are loaded onto the Illinois Link card. Household size, countable income and deductions affect the award.
sections.docs:

sections.apply:
1. Apply

    Use ABE or submit a signed paper form to your local Family Community Resource Center.

  2. Complete intake

    Follow the interview arrangements and keep the outstanding-document list.

  3. Explain an immediate food shortage

    Ask IDHS to screen the request for emergency SNAP processing.
sections.after: Read the eligibility notice and follow case reporting and review instructions. Keep the application and notices together.
sections.sources: Reviewed October 1, 2026 using Illinois SNAP eligibility and benefits, application methods. Agency staff determine eligibility.
